scope.label: World
scope.selection: Unsimplified Natural Earth 1:10m country-continent polygons, including overseas country components tagged with their parent country. Asia additionally includes Russia east of 60°E and its eastern antimeridian components west of 160°W. Europe retains its original [-25,34,60,72] bbox and unchanged assets. European territory outside that bbox not allocated to eastern Russia (including Russia north of 72°N west of 60°E) is World-only. Continents therefore do not claim an exhaustive physical-geography partition. World includes all Natural Earth land and source-uncovered outlines.
countries: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus
scope.mask: Both variables finite in all 12 months AND unsimplified selected land at grid-cell center; static sparse polygon cell map preserves annual missing cells.
scope.longitudeWrapping: Columns ordered eastward across the minimal circular longitude interval; west and cell-center longitudes may be unwrapped past 180 degrees.

smoothing.description: Fill invalid/ocean/non-region cells with this region’s annual full-precision valid-field mean, Gaussian sigma2 on the region grid, then restore the original valid mask and quantize. World sigma2 is on the stride6 grid.
smoothing.caveat: Visual smoothing biases coastal and mask-edge values toward the region annual mean; inspection and thresholds use unsmoothed values.

naturalEarth.boundaries: Natural Earth de facto country boundaries, not a statement on sovereignty.

globalAttributes.method: These layers from TerraClimate were creating using climatically aided interpolation of monthly anomalies from ERA5 with WorldClim v2.0 climatologies.
globalAttributes.title: TerraClimate: monthly climate and climatic water balance for global land surfaces
globalAttributes.summary: This archive contains a dataset of high-spatial resolution (1/24°, ~4-km) monthly climate and climatic water balance for global terrestrial surfaces from 1950-present. These data were created by using climatically aided interpolation, combining high-spatial resolution climatological normals from the WorldClim version 1.4 and version 2 datasets, with coarser resolution time varying (i.e. monthly) data from ERA5 reanalyses produce a monthly dataset of precipitation, maximum and minimum temperature, wind speed, vapor pressure, and solar radiation. TerraClimate additionally produces monthly surface water balance datasets using a water balance model that incorporates reference evapotranspiration, precipitation, temperature, and interpolated plant extractable soil water capacity. Complementary datasets are also produced for 1950-2025 for counterfactual climate scenarios that remove the first-order influence of climate change, as well as a +2C and +4C scenario that apply a pseudo climate change experiment to observational data. These datasets preserve the observed variability during 1950-2025 but adjust individual climate variables monthly using ensemble median changes derived from CMIP6.

ppt.aggregation: sum of 12 monthly accumulated precipitation fields

percentileMethod: Fixed pooled encoded raw land-cell/year histogram, NumPy linear interpolation; equal cell-year weighting, not area weighted.

generation.acquisition: Original compressed upstream HTTPServer annual files; only two source files staged per year in a newly owned temporary directory, removed after export; no existing cache deletion.

annualMaskVariation: Each year independently requires all12 finite monthly values of both variables; raw and smoothed share the same annual mask.
thresholdReference: Pooled annual World encoded raw land cells across available years 1950–2025; final target 1950–2025
